pages.name: Spanish: Open, Bernstein, 11.cxd4
pages.notes: Plan 1 suggested b3 and Bb2 with the bishop already on b3; overview called 10...d4 a gambit and missed that both b3 and d4 are attacked twice. Rewrote overview and plans. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open, Bernstein, 9...Nc5
pages.notes: Plan 1 said c3 challenges the c5-knight and routed a knight through the f1-rook; plan 2 proposed ...c7-c5 with the knight on c5; plans 3-4 were generic. Rewrote plans. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open, Bernstein, 9...Nc5 10.c3 d4
pages.notes: Plan 2 suggested Bxd4, which no bishop can play, and Nf1-e3 with the rook on f1; overview missed that ...d4 opens the e6-bishop's diagonal onto b3. Rewrote overview and plans around 11.Bxe6 Nxe6 12.cxd4 Ncxd4 and 11.Ng5.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Open, Howell Attack, Ekstrom Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 called Qe2 and Rd1 a battery; plan 2 proposed ...c5 with the knight on c6; plan 3 sent the f3-knight round via f1. Rewrote overview and plans 1-3 around the pressure on d5. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open, Keres Attack, 9...Bc5
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed a knight through the f1-rook and gave White a queenside majority it does not have. Rewrote overview and plans around Be3, Rd1 and c4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open, Keres Attack, 9...Be7
pages.notes: Plan 4 named a white e4-pawn that is gone and ...f5; plan 1 routed a knight through the f1-rook. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open, Keres, 10.Rd1
pages.notes: Plan 2's ...f5 was not a real idea here; plan 1 reworded. Rewrote plans 1-2. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open, Keres, 10.Rd1 O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the f3-knight via d2-f1; plan 3 tucked the c1-bishop to f1. Rewrote plans 1 and 3 around 11.c4 bxc4 12.Bxc4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open, Keres, 10.Rd1 O-O 11.c3
pages.notes: Plan 1 prepared a d4 break with no white d-pawn; plan 2's ...f6 did not support d5; plan 4 suggested ...Nf6, which the e5-pawn covers. Rewrote plans. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Open, Keres, 10.Rd1 O-O 11.c4
pages.notes: Plan 1 called a d5 recapture structure isolated and named a Qe2-Rd1 battery; plan 3 proposed ...d4 as a pawn sacrifice. Rewrote plans around 11...bxc4 12.Bxc4 Qd7. British spelling.
